summary: Two-line fix makes len() of rank-0 arrays return 1, matching numpy semantics and the iterator's element count. Minimal, correct, no regression risk for higher-rank arrays.

issues.description: Special-casing shape==() in __len__ patches the symptom rather than fixing _loop_size at construction; a cleaner fix would set _loop_size=1 for rank-0 so all consumers agree. Acceptable as-is.
